title: Plot Twist: still typing
old_caption: The dots go on, off, on, and Aries has pictured a twelve-part essay. The message: can I call you instead? Some people just want to hear your voice.

title: Plot Twist: "we need to talk"
old_caption: Libra rehearsed every bad ending in the mirror and walked to the bench like a movie. It was a talk card: what made you smile this week? Answer in the comments.

title: If the Fire Signs Were Weather
old_caption: Aries is the sunny day in winter that makes everyone ditch their scarves. Leo is golden hour that never ends. Sag is the tailwind that takes your kite somewhere new.

title: If the Earth Signs Were Weather
old_caption: Taurus is blanket-and-drizzle weather. Virgo checked twice, it's clear, and brought you an umbrella anyway. Capricorn: frosty hello, warm by noon. Which one are you?

title: If the Air Signs Were Weather
old_caption: Gemini is partly sunny, partly cloudy and talking the whole time. Libra is the perfect breeze. Aquarius is a cloud shaped like a question mark. Who's your forecast?

title: If the Water Signs Were Weather
old_caption: Cancer is the rainy night you stay in. Scorpio is fog that lifts and shows you everything. Pisces is a sun shower, crying and glowing at once. Who are you on a rainy night?

title: If the Signs Were Winter Weather
old_caption: Sagittarius is the first snow, everyone sprinting outside. Capricorn is a clear, freezing night full of stars. Cancer is the frosted window you draw a heart on.

title: Little Treat: Aries listened
old_caption: Aries let a whole story finish without jumping in, let them pick the place, and said "I like you" first. Three wins, three treats, and one surprise cupcake. What's your treat?

title: Little Treat: Cancer went out
old_caption: Cancer left the house, made it through the movie with dry eyes (Pisces cried enough for both), and said what it needs out loud. That last one gets a whole cake.

title: Little Treat: Capricorn logged off
old_caption: Out the door at 6:00 on the dot, phone face down at dinner, and someone else got to make the plan. Capricorn deserves every single pretzel. Who needs to log off tonight?
